title: Cap-Aware Boosting for Green Day-Ahead Electricity Price Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.21149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate forecasting of Green Day-Ahead Market (GDAM) electricity prices is essential for market participants in the Indian power sector. We present a LightGBM-based forecasting framework for Indian Energy Exchange GDAM prices, which clear in 96 fifteen-minute intervals per day. The proposed system explicitly models price-cap behavior by separating capped-price events from normal market conditions. A classification head estimates the probability of the regulatory price cap (Rs 10,000/MWh), while a regression head predicts uncapped prices in logarithmic space. Final forecasts are obtained through probabilistic blending of these components and are accompanied by nine quantile forecasts for uncertainty estimation. translated_title: 面向绿色日前电价预测的价格上限感知Boosting方法
translated_abstract: 对绿色日前市场（GDAM）电价的准确预测对印度电力行业的市场参与者至关重要。我们提出了一种基于LightGBM的印度能源交易所GDAM价格预测框架，该市场每天以96个15分钟时段出清。所提出的系统通过将触及价格上限的事件与正常市场条件分离，显式地建模价格上限行为。其中一个分类头估计触及监管价格上限（10,000卢比/兆瓦时）的概率，另一个回归头在对数空间中预测未触及上限的价格。最终预测通过对这两个组成部分进行概率融合获得，并附带九个分位数预测用于不确定性估计。在2026年1月1日至9月14日的257个交易日的评估中，该模型实现了397.9卢比/兆瓦时的平均绝对误差（MAE）和9.57%的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），显著优于Chronos-2基线模型。
tldr: 提出了一种价格上限感知的LightGBM预测框架，通过分类头估计触及价格上限的概率、回归头在对数空间预测未封顶价格，并结合概率融合与九分位数不确定性估计，显著提升了印度绿色日前市场电价预测精度。
en_tdlr: A cap-aware LightGBM framework that combines a classification head for price-cap probability with a regression head for uncapped prices, achieving substantially improved GDAM electricity price forecasting accuracy over Chronos-2.
